argv: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue';$r=[ordered]@{};$bin='E:\PC-Control\TunnelChrome-20261009\full\tunnel-client.exe';$help=(& $bin --help 2>&1) -join ' ';$r.helpLines=@(($help -split [char]10)|Select-Object -First 26|ForEach-Object{([string]$_).Trim()});$ids=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'tunnel-client.exe'" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Select-Object -ExpandProperty ProcessId);$r.listenPorts=@(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Where-Object{$ids -contains $_.OwningProcess}|ForEach-Object{$_.LocalPort}|Sort-Object -Unique);foreach($port in $r.listenPorts){foreach($endpoint in @('readyz','healthz')){try{$resp=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:'+ $port+'/'+$endpoint) -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 2;$r['url_'+$port+'_'+$endpoint]=@{status=[int]$resp.StatusCode;body=if($resp.Content.Length -lt 1200){$resp.Content}else{'too_long'}}}catch{$r['url_'+$port+'_'+$endpoint]='unreachable'}}};$r|ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 5
